text:
:= by
induction n with d hd
· exact le_refl (n + 1)
· have h1 : 2 ^ d * 2 ≤ 2 ^ (d + 1) := by rw [pow_add, mul_two]; exact le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_zero (2 ^ d)) (le_zero 2)
  have h2 : 2 ^ d * (d + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (d + 1) := by apply Nat.two_pow_mul_factorial_le_factorial_two_mul; exact le_rfl
  have h3 : d + 1 ≤ 2 ^ d := hd
  calc
    n + 1 = (d + 1) + 1 := by simp
    ... ≤ 2 ^ d + 1 := add_le_add_left h3 1
    ... ≤ 2 ^ d + 2 ^ d := add_le_add_left h1 2 ^ d
    ... = 2 ^ (d + 1) := by rw [pow_add, mul_two]
